title: Action handler
statement: Each action's handler MUST load the records it changes whole, refuse by the broken rule's name and change nothing when a rule fails, and save what it changed in one write.

title: Route
statement: Each route MUST take its action's details as JSON, run its one command or query, and answer with what was saved or read, or with the refusal and its reason.

title: Domain code
statement: Each rule, predicate, value type, service and event type MUST say in code exactly what its record in the domain model says, reading only what that record reads.

title: Stored record
statement: Each repository, with its tables and row types, MUST load an aggregate whole from the library's database and save exactly that aggregate's rows back.

title: Read model
statement: Each read model's projection, reader and query handlers MUST answer from the read model's own rows alone, filled from the records and events it reads.

title: Tooling
statement: Each script and config file MUST build, check, run or report on the library's own code as written, adding no rule the domain model does not state.

title: Outside system
statement: Each adapter MUST hand an outside system exactly what the policy or step that exchanges with it gives, and throw when the system cannot take it, deciding nothing the domain model does not state.
